--- page 4 ---
MODELS
ACTIV
Spark ACTIV is the nimble compact car for those who prefer a slightly
sportier look.
Standard equipment includes unique front and rear bumpers, rocker
panel trim, roof rails, fender flares, 15-inch Gunmetal Silver-painted
aluminum wheels and front fog lamps with chrome rings. Jet Black
leatherette heated front seats and a leather-wrapped steering wheel
add the finishing touches. The rest is up to you.
2LT
A Spark with plenty of style and available safety features.
To help alert you to potential dangers, 2LT offers an available
Driver Confidence Package including Forward Collision Alert,1 Lane
Departure Warning1 and Automatic Emergency Braking.1 You’ll also
find Keyless Open and Start and Rear Park Assist,1 which can help
guide you while parking in tight spots.
1 Safety or driver assistance features are no substitute for the driver’s responsibility to operate the vehicle in a safe manner. The driver should remain attentive to traffic, surroundings and road conditions at all times. Visibility, weather and road conditions
may affect feature performance. Read the vehicle Owner’s Manual for more important feature limitations and information.
